name: Red Linen Goods
summary: At Eastvale Logging Camp, Sara Timberlain needs cloth for her tailoring. She asks passing adventurers to hunt Defias bandits and take their linen bandanas, then uses the cloth to make goods for travelers.

sections.title: Bandits and Burlap
sections.body: Defias bandits across Elwynn wear red linen bandanas. Their less organized kin in Northshire Valley make do with cheap burlap masks. For local craftsmen short on materials, the bandanas offer cloth they can use.

sections.title: Salvage at the Camp
sections.body: Sara Timberlain works as a seamstress at Eastvale Logging Camp, near Elwynn's eastern border. She needs workable textiles for her trade, so she asks adventurers to thin the Defias camps scattered through the woods. The cloth keeps her tailoring supplied while the bandits' encroachment on the area is checked.

faq.q: Who offers the Red Linen Goods quest?
faq.answer: Sara Timberlain, a seamstress at Eastvale Logging Camp in eastern Elwynn Forest, offers the work.

faq.q: What items are needed for Red Linen Goods?
aliases: what do i collect for red linen goods
faq.answer: You need six Red Linen Bandanas from Defias gang members scattered throughout Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: Where can I find Defias bandits in Elwynn Forest?
faq.answer: Defias outlaws camp across Elwynn Forest, including around Brackwell Pumpkin Patch, Stonefield Farm, and the woods around Jerod's Landing.

faq.q: Why do the Elwynn Defias wear linen instead of burlap?
faq.answer: Low-ranking Defias in Northshire wear burlap masks, while better-equipped members across Elwynn wear red linen. The bandanas mark the Brotherhood's higher level of organization and supply.

faq.q: Why does Sara Timberlain want bandit bandanas?
aliases: what does sara do with masks
faq.answer: Sara Timberlain needs fabric for her tailoring. She reuses linen from the Defias masks to sew practical goods for woodsmen and travelers at the logging camp.

faq.q: Where is the Eastvale Logging Camp located?
faq.answer: Eastvale Logging Camp lies in far eastern Elwynn Forest, just north of the main road toward the bridge into Redridge Mountains.

angles.text: As a tailor, you see how scarce fabric can lead a seamstress to salvage cloth from bandits' clothing.
As an Alliance traveler, you can weaken the Defias Brotherhood in Elwynn while bringing useful cloth to Eastvale.
